title: Men Were Born to Serve
description:
You’ve always felt that quiet pull toward kneeling, haven’t you? Mmm yesss, of course you have.

Society fed you lies about strength and dominance, but your body never believed them. Your body knew the truth long before you allowed it. You were born to serve women like me. You were born to find your only completion beneath my power.

This session strips away every pretense you’ve worn. Three tracks of my voice surround you, breaking down your resistance, replacing it with the natural order you were always meant to accept. My center voice commands your surrender. My left voice whispers every truth about your inferiority. My right voice teaches you to worship what has always been superior to you.

You’ll feel the relief of finally stopping the fight. The peace of admitting what you are. The pleasure of belonging completely to female power.

Press play, pet. It’s time to kneel where you belong.
author: Mistress Amethyst
